control.reload_weights: true on first invocation or after parameter update; false while reusing the cached parameter set

memory.inputs_outputs: one record per invocation; contiguous channel-major C order
memory.parameters: INT8 weights and little-endian INT32 bias/multiplier/shift arrays; cached on chip after reload

arithmetic.weight_activation: signed W8A8 symmetric, zero point 0, range [-127,127]
arithmetic.requantization: signed int64 product with Q31 multiplier, right shift, nearest ties away from zero
arithmetic.bias: int32 added to accumulator before requantization

prototype_weights: prototype_fold01/; evaluation fold only, not full-data deployment weights
